# Data Source: tfe_no_code_module

Gets a public or private existing no-code module.

## Example Usage

```csharp
using Constructs;
using HashiCorp.Cdktf;
/*Provider bindings are generated by running cdktf get.
See https://cdk.tf/provider-generation for more details.*/
using Gen.Providers.Tfe;
class MyConvertedCode : TerraformStack
{
    public MyConvertedCode(Construct scope, string name) : base(scope, name)
    {
        var tfeOrganizationFoobar = new Organization.Organization(this, "foobar", new OrganizationConfig {
            Email = "admin@company.com",
            Name = "my-org-name"
        });
        var tfeRegistryModuleFoobar = new RegistryModule.RegistryModule(this, "foobar_1", new RegistryModuleConfig {
            ModuleProvider = "my_provider",
            Name = "test_module",
            Organization = Token.AsString(tfeOrganizationFoobar.Id)
        });
        /*This allows the Terraform resource name to match the original name. You can remove the call if you don't need them to match.*/
        tfeRegistryModuleFoobar.OverrideLogicalId("foobar");
        var tfeNoCodeModuleFoobar = new NoCodeModule.NoCodeModule(this, "foobar_2", new NoCodeModuleConfig {
            Organization = Token.AsString(tfeOrganizationFoobar.Id),
            RegistryModule = Token.AsString(tfeRegistryModuleFoobar.Id)
        });
        /*This allows the Terraform resource name to match the original name. You can remove the call if you don't need them to match.*/
        tfeNoCodeModuleFoobar.OverrideLogicalId("foobar");
        var dataTfeNoCodeModuleFoobar =
        new DataTfeNoCodeModule.DataTfeNoCodeModule(this, "foobar_3", new DataTfeNoCodeModuleConfig {
            Id = Token.AsString(tfeNoCodeModuleFoobar.Id)
        });
        /*This allows the Terraform resource name to match the original name. You can remove the call if you don't need them to match.*/
        dataTfeNoCodeModuleFoobar.OverrideLogicalId("foobar");
    }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `Id` (String) ID of the no-code module.

### Read-Only

- `Enabled` (Boolean) Indicates if this no-code module is currently enabled.
- `Namespace` (String) The namespace of the no-code module.
- `Organization` (String) Name of the organization.
- `RegistryModuleId` (String) ID of the registry module.
- `VersionPin` (String) Version pin of the no-code module.
